items.title: Banning Open Source AI Would Be A Mistake
items.summary: This post was originally an op-ed co-authored with of Interconnected for a general, non-technical audience. The gatekeepers — the many media outlets we pitched it to — passed on publishing it. Luckily, we have our own platforms to get the message out. Please help us forward this op-ed to any one you know who is on the fence about open source AI or new to the topic and want to learn more. Thank you. Share The energy t
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了美国针对人工智能的潜在监管政策，并论证了禁止或过度限制开源AI可能对经济和技术创新带来的负面影响。
